summary: MERN Stack Developer Internship in Kerala offers a chance to work with cutting-edge technologies and gain real-world experience.
responsibilities: Assist in the development of web applications using the MERN stack.
Collaborate with team members to define, design, and ship new features.
Debug and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal application performance.
Participate in code reviews and contribute feedback to improve coding standards.
Research and implement new technologies to enhance existing applications.
Work closely with UI/UX designers to create user-friendly interfaces.
Develop and integrate APIs for improved functionality.
Document development processes and maintain clear communication with the team.
required_skills: Basic understanding of JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks.
Familiarity with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
nice_to_have_skills: Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
A willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and practices.
